authority.directive: 第七步之前先做测试比如说design review和code review

trigger: 在冻结 M7 实证前增加设计审查、代码审查、测试审查和修复验收，以防止未来泄漏、账本漏计和不可复现的模型增量。

change.ordering: M6 PASS -> M6.5 PASS -> M7 contract/data/code/execution
required_artifacts: M6 test revalidation and archival verification design

non_changes: A-share daily market, label, primary 50 features, rolling split and final-OOS boundary
M3 PIT product and M6 historical MSE evidence
final-OOS seal and current 44 recorded model fits

acceptance.pass_condition: All M6.5 P0/P1/P2 findings are fixed, independently re-reviewed, and have fresh test/evidence receipts before any M7 real fit.
acceptance.failure_retention: Every review finding and failed receipt remains in evidence/m6_5_pre_m7; M7 remains NOT_RUN.
